get.description: Browser-only Passkey ceremony. Requires scoped X-Browser-Client, exact configured site Origin and CSRF for mutations. Challenges expire after 300 seconds and have one attempt. Registration requires a current password and a login completed within the last five minutes including existing MFA. User verification and resident credentials are required. Password fallback and existing MFA remain in force. Browser login returns only a scoped HttpOnly session projection, never a bearer token. Removing a credential revokes all account sessions and pending security/authorization proofs. Session exchange or token migration does not refresh the five-minute authentication assurance. Legacy sessions without a trusted authentication timestamp must sign in again. Origins use browser serialization, omitting default ports. No attestation certificates or private keys are retained.
